scope: Optional descriptive local alignment evidence for every exact retained native primitive; inference and default calls are not changed.
candidate_selection: All retained exact primitive geometries, before local-support or coefficient selection, including unassessable boundaries and candidates without a modeled carrier.
coordinates: Zero-based reference boundaries with retained sides L/R.
support_unit: Distinct read names; the supplied HiFi input must use one name per physical CCS molecule.
reference_check: All BAM SQ names and lengths must agree with the supplied reference; missing BAM contigs remain unassessable per target. Available SQ M5 values are checked. Missing M5 does not attest historical alignment-reference generation.
model_reference_check: Record all native-node chromosome-length disagreements with the supplied reference. Every candidate endpoint on such a chromosome is unassessable, retaining the candidate and original N. No chromosome-specific exception, coordinate correction or mismatch suppression is performed.
export: Optional supported-only reciprocal BND records, all FILTER=ExperimentalEvidence, QUAL missing, no genotype or sample columns.
limitations: Local alignment support is not biological existence, unique locus origin, insertion-sequence identity, full-chain linkage or calibrated accuracy.
HiFi input may also have been used for assembly; no independent validation is claimed. The declared assembly-input relationship is recorded separately.
Conditional flank exposure is not a VAF denominator, strict spanning opportunity or detection-power estimate.
Conditional model contribution N is not absolute copy number, purity, ploidy or clone fraction, and zero is not biological absence.
Normal, ONT, whole-chain and dosage-identifiability assessments are unmeasured unless separately supplied by another explicit analysis.
Exact geometries and nearby/shared-read relations are retained. Shared molecules do not prove that different adjacencies are the same allele or independent new events.
